reviews.text: The massage was okay and helped me relax after months of traveling, plus the location is convenient to my apartment. However, the nail service was highly disappointing. The clippers used weren't sharp enough for my cuticles, and my polish started chipping after only two days. To make matters worse, the staff held a loud meeting inside during my service. It was so noisy it completely ruined the spa atmosphere, and I actually had to ask the lady to close the door. Very disappointed.
reviews.owner_reply:
Dear Ms. Krista,

Thank you for taking the time to share your honest feedback with us. We're glad to hear that you found the massage relaxing and appreciated our convenient location.

We sincerely apologize that your nail service and the atmosphere during your visit did not meet your expectations. Your comments regarding the nail tools, the longevity of the polish, and the noise caused by the staff meeting are taken very seriously. This is not the experience we strive to provide, and we will address these concerns with our team to ensure better service and a more peaceful environment for all our clients.

We truly appreciate your feedback, as it helps us improve, and we hope to have the opportunity to provide you with the exceptional experience you deserve in the future.

Glamorously grateful,
The Simply Beauty Salon & Spa Team.

reviews.author: Chaithu NB
reviews.text:
I’m honestly disappointed with my recent experience at this salon. I had taken a manicure and pedicure package, which was explained to me as gel. At the reception, I was told that nail art would cost AED 15 extra, which I agreed to.

However, once I went inside and showed a very simple design, the staff said they couldn’t do it. When I asked about the AED 15 nail art charge, they then changed the explanation and said AED 15 is only for ONE finger, which was never clearly mentioned earlier. This felt misleading and confusing.

Instead of offering alternatives, they kept insisting that I choose from the colors they suggested, and the final color applied did not suit my skin tone at all. There was no professional guidance.

On top of this, I was not informed beforehand that there would be an additional charge for removing my previous nail paint. This was only told to me at the time of billing, which felt very unprofessional. Again, it’s not about the money — it’s about how the lack of transparency made me feel as a customer. I ended up paying for a service that I was not satisfied with, which is disappointing.

The only positive part of my visit was the threading service, which was done well.

Overall, I feel the salon really needs to improve on clear communication, honest pricing, and customer satisfaction.

reviews.author: Muzayn Nisar
reviews.text:
Arleen is very good at haircuts, and I would recommend this salon for a simple, budget-friendly haircut. However, I found many of the other services to be overpriced for what they offer.

One thing that concerned me was being encouraged to leave a 5-star review and positive feedback before even leaving the salon. Reviews should be voluntary and reflect a customer’s genuine experience. Many people rely on online reviews when deciding where to go, so it is important that feedback remains honest and authentic rather than being pressured or influenced.

Overall, I would recommend the salon for haircuts, especially if you’re looking for an affordable option, but I believe customer reviews should be collected in a more transparent and unbiased way.
reviews.owner_reply:
Dear Ms. Muzayn Nisar,

Thank you for taking the time to share your honest feedback. We’re pleased to hear that you were happy with your haircut and that Ms. Arlene’s work left a positive impression on you. Your recommendation for our haircut services is truly appreciated.

We also value your concerns regarding your experience and the way review requests were communicated. At Simply Beauty Salon & Spa, we strive to create a comfortable and respectful environment for every client, and your feedback serves as an important reminder for us to continually improve our approach and ensure that all reviews are shared voluntarily and authentically.

Thank you again for your constructive comments. We appreciate your support and hope to have the opportunity to provide you with an even better experience in the future.

Glamorously grateful,
The Simply Beauty Salon & Spa Team
